name: Canary Islands
about: One of the few places that stays genuinely warm and sunny even in January — there's no real off-season.
overview: Subtropical volcanic islands off West Africa — black-sand beaches, Tenerife's Mount Teide, and a genuinely mild, sunny climate.
costOverview: Among the cheapest destinations in Europe — a full three-course lunch with a drink costs well under what you'd pay for just a main course on the mainland.
